x: With Matt Yates chasing a World Cup place and producing a season's best to win the 1500m, plus maximum points from Justin Chaston and Lee Hurst in the steeplechase, and then further maximum points in the 5000m from Paul Evans and Kassa Tadessa, we looked invincible.

Once again Kassa Tadessa ensured maximum points in the 5000. Our only other track win was by Lee Hurst in the 'A' Steeplechase, although Tom Lerwill only lost the 800 by a vest thickness (according to the official photograph) being given the same time of 1.49.19 as the winner – Justin Swift Smith of Shaftesbury Barnet.
